wiki.title: Mike Vondran
wiki.extract: Michael Vondran (born 1961) is an American politician and businessman who has represented the 94th district of the Iowa House of Representatives since January 2023, which consists of parts of central Scott County, including most of Eldridge and much of central Davenport. He is a member of the Republican Party.
